<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n1" type="main" key="a)=" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἆ</orth>: interjection expressive

            <gloss>Ah! wretched pair!</gloss>
          <bibl n="Hom. Il. 17.443" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 17.443</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 11.816" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 11.816</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 14.361" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
          14.361</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n2" type="main" key="a)a/atos" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀ-α?α_τος</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἀϝάω</foreign>): of doubtful meaning. —(1)
            <gloss>inviolable</gloss> (if <foreign lang="greek">α</foreign>
          privative), <foreign lang="greek">νυν μοι ὄμοσσον ἀα?α_τον Στυγὸς
            υ?δωρ</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 14.271" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 14.271</bibl>; cf.
            <foreign lang="greek">Στυγὸς υ?δωρ, ὅς τε μέγιστος</foreign>
          | <foreign lang="greek">ὅρκος δεινότατός τε πέλει
            μακάρεσσι θεοῖσιν</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 15.37" default="NO" valid="yes">Il.
            15.37</bibl> f.—(2) <gloss>baleful</gloss> (if <foreign lang="greek">α</foreign> copulative), or <gloss>mad</gloss>, of the
          suitors' contest with the bow, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 21.81" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            21.81</bibl> (echoed by Odysseus, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 22.5" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            22.5</bibl>). —Signif. (2) may be assumed in <bibl n="Hom. Il. 14" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 14</bibl> instead of (1), representing the Styx
          as baleful to him who swears falsely in its name.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n6" type="main" key="a)a/w" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">α<*>᾿α<*>´ω</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἀϝάω</foreign>), aor. <foreign lang="greek">α<*>῎α<*>σε, ἆσε</foreign>, 2 sing.
            <foreign lang="greek">ἆσας</foreign>, mid. <foreign lang="greek">ἀᾶται</foreign>, aor. <foreign lang="greek">α<*>᾿α<*>σάμην, -ατο,
          α?σατο</foreign>, pass. aor. <foreign lang="greek">ἀάσθην, -ης,
            -η</foreign>, part. <foreign lang="greek">-είς</foreign>: I. act.,
            <gloss>bring to grief</gloss>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 8.237" default="NO" valid="yes">Il.
            8.237</bibl>; esp. of the mind, <gloss>delude, befool,
            befuddle</gloss>, <foreign lang="greek">ὃ δ᾽ ἐπεὶ φρένας α?ασεν
            οἴνῳ</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 21.297" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 21.297</bibl>; pass.,
            <bibl n="Hom. Il. 19.136" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 19.136</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 21.301" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 21.301</bibl>
          <foreign lang="greek">; μέγα,</foreign>
          <bibl n="Hom. Il. 16.685" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 16.685</bibl>; <foreign lang="greek">
            πολλόν</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 19.113" default="NO" valid="yes">Il.
          19.113</bibl>.—II. mid., <gloss>commit folly, be infatuated,
            deceive oneself</gloss>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 19.95" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 19.95</bibl>;
          causative, ‘<gloss>beguile</gloss>,’ (<foreign lang="greek">?῎ατη</foreign>), <foreign lang="greek">ἣ πάντας
            ἀᾶται</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 19.91" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 19.91</bibl>,
          129.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n15" type="main" key="a)blhxro/s" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀ-βληχρός</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">α</foreign> prothetic, <foreign lang="greek">μαλακός</foreign>): <gloss>soft, feeble, gentle</gloss>, <foreign lang="greek">χείρ, τείχεα, θάνατος,</foreign>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n16" type="main" key="a)/bromos" opt="n">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n18" type="main" key="a)/brotos" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἄ-βροτος</orth> (=<foreign lang="greek">ἄμβροτος</foreign>): <gloss>divine</gloss>, <foreign lang="greek">νὺξ ἀβρότη</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 14.78" default="NO" valid="yes">Il.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n19" type="main" key="*)/abudos" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">Ἄβυ_δος</orth>:
            <gloss>Abȳdus</gloss>, a town on the southern shore of the
          Hellespont, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.836" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 2.836</bibl>
          <foreign lang="greek">.—Ἀβυ_δόθεν</foreign>: <gloss>from
            Abȳdus</gloss>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 4.500" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 4.500</bibl>
          <foreign lang="greek">. —Ἀβυ_δόθι</foreign>: <gloss>in

            17.584</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n21" type="main" key="a)ga/asqai" opt="n">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n24" type="main" key="a)gaqo/s" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγαθός</orth>:
            <gloss>good.</gloss>—Hence (1) of persons,
          ‘valiant,’ ‘brave,’ <foreign lang="greek">ἢ κακὸς ἢ ἀγαθός</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 17.632" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 17.632</bibl>;
          ‘skilful,’ <foreign lang="greek">ι?ητῆρ᾽
            ἀγαθώ</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.732" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 2.732</bibl>, freq. w.
          acc. of specification or an adv., <foreign lang="greek">βοήν,
            πύξ</foreign>.—Often ‘noble’ (cf.
          optimates), opp. <foreign lang="greek">χέρηες</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 15.324" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 15.324</bibl>.— (2) of things,
          ‘excellent,’ ‘useful,’ etc.;
            <foreign lang="greek">ἀγαθόν τε κακόν τε</foreign>,
          ‘blessing <pb n="2" /> and curse,’ <bibl n="Hom. Od. 4.237" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 4.237</bibl>
          <foreign lang="greek">; ἀγαθοῖσι γεραίρειν</foreign>, ‘honor
          with choice portions,’ <bibl n="Hom. Od. 14.441" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            14.441</bibl>
          <foreign lang="greek">; ἀγαθὰ φρονεῖν</foreign>, ‘wish one
          well,’ <bibl n="Hom. Od. 1.43" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 1.43</bibl>;
          ‘be pure-minded,’ <bibl n="Hom. Il. 6.162" default="NO" valid="yes">Il.
            6.162</bibl>
          <foreign lang="greek">; εἰς ἀγαθόν</foreign> or <foreign lang="greek">ἀγαθὰ εἰπεῖν</foreign>, ‘speak with friendly
          intent;’ <foreign lang="greek">εἰς ἀγ. πείθεσθαι</foreign>,
          ‘follow good counsel.’</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n25" type="main" key="*)aga/qwn" opt="n">

            <bibl n="Hom. Il. 24.249" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 24.249</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n26" type="main" key="a)gai/omai" opt="n">

          20.16</bibl>†; cf. <bibl n="Hom. Od. 2.67" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
          2.67</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n27" type="main" key="a)gakleh/s" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγα-κλεής</orth>, gen. <foreign lang="greek">ἀγακλῆος</foreign> (<foreign lang="greek">κλέος</foreign>): <gloss>highly renowned.</gloss>
        </entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n28" type="main" key="*)agakle/hs" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">Ἀγακλέης</orth>: a Myrmidon,
            <bibl n="Hom. Il. 16.571" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 16.571</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n29" type="main" key="a)gakleito/s" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγα-κλειτός</orth>: <gloss>highly
            renowned, famous</gloss>, epith. of men, of a Nereid, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 18.45" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 18.45</bibl>, and of hecatombs.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n30" type="main" key="a)gakluto/s" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγα-κλυτός</orth> =<foreign lang="greek">ἀγακλεής, ἀγακλειτός</foreign>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n31" type="main" key="a)ga/llomai" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγάλλομαι</orth>: <gloss>take
            delight</gloss> or <gloss>pride in</gloss> (<foreign lang="greek">τινί</foreign>); <foreign lang="greek">ἀγαλλόμενα
            πτερύγεσσιν</foreign>, ‘on exultant wings,’ <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.462" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 2.462</bibl>; met. of ships,
          ‘revelling in the fair breeze’ (<foreign lang="greek">Διὸς οὔρῳ</foreign>), <bibl n="Hom. Od. 5.176" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            5.176</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n32" type="main" key="a)/galma" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἄγαλμα</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἀγάλλομαι</foreign>): anything in which one takes
            <gloss>delight</gloss> or <gloss>pride</gloss>, a
          ‘treasure,’ <bibl n="Hom. Il. 4.144" default="NO" valid="yes">Il.
            4.144</bibl>; applied to votive offerings, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 3.274" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 3.274</bibl>; a sacrificial victim, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 3.438" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 3.438</bibl>; horses, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 4.602" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
          4.602</bibl>; personal adornments, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 18.300" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            18.300</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n33" type="main" key="a)/gamai" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἄγαμαι</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἄγη</foreign>), fut. <foreign lang="greek">ἀγάσσεσθαι</foreign>, aor.
            <foreign lang="greek">ἠγασάμην, ἠγασσάμην</foreign> (also
          unaugmented), and from parallel form <foreign lang="greek">ἀγάομαι,
            ἀγάασθε, ἀγάασθαι</foreign>, ipf. <foreign lang="greek">ἠγάασθε</foreign>. The form <foreign lang="greek">ἄγαμαι</foreign>
          only in signif. 1:— (1) <gloss>admire, wonder at, be
            amazed</gloss>, <foreign lang="greek">θαυμάζειν οὔτ᾽
            ἀγάασθαι</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 16.203" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
          16.203</bibl>.—(2) in bad sense, <gloss>be indignant
            at</gloss>, w. acc. <bibl n="Hom. Od. 2.67" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 2.67</bibl>, w. dat.
            <bibl n="Hom. Od. 8.565" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 8.565</bibl>; <gloss>be vexed</gloss>,

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n34" type="main" key="*)agamemnone/h" opt="n">

<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n35" type="main" key="*)agamemnoni/dhs" opt="n">

            1.30</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n36" type="main" key="*)agame/mnwn" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">Ἀγαμέμνων</orth>:
            <gloss>Agamemnon</gloss>, son of Atreus and grandson of Tantalus;
          his wife, Clytaemnestra, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 1.113" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 1.113</bibl> f.;
          his children, Orestes, Chrysothemis, Laodice, and Iphianassa, cf.
            <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.104" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 2.104</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 9.287" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 9.287</bibl>. King of Mycēnae, likewise ruler over
          ‘many islands and all Argos,’ <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.108" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 2.108</bibl>. His wealth in ships, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.576" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 2.576</bibl>, 610-614. Epithets, <foreign lang="greek">δῖος, κρείων, εὐρυκρείων, ἄναξ ἄνδρῶν, ποιμὴν
            λα_ῶν</foreign>. His stature, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 3.166" default="NO" valid="yes">Il.
            3.166</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 3.178" default="NO" valid="yes">178</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.477" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 2. 477-483</bibl>; <foreign lang="greek">ἀριστεία_</foreign>, ‘exploits,’ <bibl n="Hom. Il. 11.91" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 11.91</bibl>-661; honor accorded to him,
            <bibl n="Hom. Il. 23.887" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 23.887</bibl>; sceptre, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.104" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 2.104</bibl>; his return from Troy, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 3.143" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 3.143</bibl> ff., <bibl n="Hom. Od. 3.156" default="NO" valid="yes">156</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 3.193" default="NO" valid="yes">193 ff.</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 3.234" default="NO" valid="yes">234 f.</bibl>; his death at the hands of
          Aegisthus and Clytaemnestra, his wife, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 3.248" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            3.248</bibl> ff., <bibl n="Hom. Od. 4.91" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 4.91</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 4.512" default="NO" valid="yes">512-537</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 4.584" default="NO" valid="yes">584</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 11.387" default="NO" valid="yes">l 387-463</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 24.20" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 24.20</bibl>-97.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n37" type="main" key="*)agamh/dh" opt="n">

<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n38" type="main" key="a)/gamos" opt="n">

<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n39" type="main" key="a)ga/nnifos" opt="n">

          (Il.)</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n40" type="main" key="a)gano/s" opt="n">

          <foreign lang="greek">; εὐχωλαι,</foreign>
          <bibl n="Hom. Il. 9.499" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 9.499</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 13.357" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 13.357</bibl>; <foreign lang="greek"> οἷς ἀγανοῖς
            βελέεσσι</foreign>, ‘with his (her) gentle
          shafts,’ describing a (natural) sudden, painless death dealt
          by Apollo upon men, by Artemis upon women, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 3.280" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 3.280</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n41" type="main" key="a)ganofrosu/nh" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγανο-φροσύνη</orth>:
            <gloss>gentle-mindedness, kindliness</gloss>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 11.203" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 11.203</bibl>; cf. <bibl n="Hom. Od. 2.230" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 2.230</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

            20.467</bibl>†.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

            21.289</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n46" type="main" key="a)gaph/nwr" opt="n">

        </entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n47" type="main" key="*)agaph/nwr" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">Ἀγαπήνωρ</orth>: <foreign lang="greek">Ἀγκαίοιο πάϊς</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.609" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 2.609</bibl>, king of the Arcadians, a vassal of Agamemnon, to

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n48" type="main" key="a)gaphto/s" opt="n">

            <foreign lang="greek">παῖς</foreign>, <gloss>son</gloss>, which is

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n51" type="main" key="a)ga/stonos" opt="n">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n53" type="main" key="*)agau/h" opt="n">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n54" type="main" key="a)gauo/s" opt="n">

            <gloss>illustrious, high-born</gloss>, epith. of honor applied to
          rulers and nations; freq. to the suitors; to the noble <foreign lang="greek">πομπηες</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 13.71" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            13.71</bibl>; to Tithōnus, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 5.1" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            5.1</bibl>; and thrice to Persephone.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n55" type="main" key="a)ggeli/h" opt="n">

            <bibl n="Hom. Od. 2.30" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 2.30</bibl>;

            5.150</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 7.263" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 7.263</bibl>
          <foreign lang="greek">; ἀγγ. ἐλθόντα</foreign>, ‘on a

          <bibl n="Hom. Il. 11.140" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 11.140</bibl>; in <bibl n="Hom. Il. 3.206" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 3.206</bibl> gen. of cause or purpose,
          according to some authorities, but see <foreign lang="greek">ἀγγελίης</foreign>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n56" type="main" key="a)ggeli/hs" opt="n">

            <bibl n="Hom. Il. 4.384" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 4.384</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 11.140" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 11.140</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

          15.159</bibl>: <gloss>report, announce</gloss> (<foreign lang="greek">τὶ</foreign>, also <foreign lang="greek">τινά</foreign>); w. inf.

          16.350</bibl>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 8.517" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 8.517</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n58" type="main" key="a)/ggelos" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἄγγελος</orth>:
            <gloss>messenger;</gloss> common phrase, <foreign lang="greek">ἦλθέ
            τινι,</foreign>
          <bibl n="Hom. Il. 11.715" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 11.715</bibl>; <foreign lang="greek">
            Ὄσσα Διὸς ἄγγελος</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Il. 2.94" default="NO" valid="yes">Il.
            2.94</bibl>; also of birds, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 15.526" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            15.526</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n59" type="main" key="a)/ggos" opt="n">

            2.289</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n60" type="main" key="a)/ge" opt="n">

          ἄγε</foreign>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n61" type="main" key="a)gei/rw" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγείρω</orth>, aor. <foreign lang="greek">ἤγειρα</foreign>, pass. pf. <foreign lang="greek">ἀγήγερμαι</foreign>, aor. <foreign lang="greek">ἠγέρθην</foreign>, 3
          pl. <foreign lang="greek">ἄγερθεν</foreign>, mid. 2 aor. <foreign lang="greek">ἀγερόμην</foreign>, inf. <foreign lang="greek">ἀγερέσθαι</foreign> (accented <foreign lang="greek">ἀγέρεσθαι</foreign> by ancient grammarians), part. <foreign lang="greek">ἀγρόμενος</foreign>: <gloss>collect, call together,

            together;</gloss>

          ‘consciousness’ (‘presence of

          ‘was restored.’</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n62" type="main" key="a)gelai=os" opt="n">

            <foreign lang="greek">βοῦς, βόες</foreign>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n63" type="main" key="*)age/laos" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">Ἀγέλα_ος</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἄγω, λαός</foreign>): (1) a Trojan, son of Phradmon,
            <bibl n="Hom. Il. 8.257" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 8.257</bibl>.—(2) a Greek,
            <bibl n="Hom. Il. 11.302" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 11.302</bibl>.—(3) a suitor,
          son of Damastor, <foreign lang="greek">Ἀγέλεως</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 22.131" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 22.131</bibl>, 247.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n64" type="main" key="a)gelei/h" opt="n">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n123" type="main" key="a)gro/menos" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγρόμενος</orth>: see <foreign lang="greek">ἀγείρω</foreign>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n124" type="main" key="a)gro/nde" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγρόνδε</orth>: <gloss>to the
            field, country</gloss>, i. e. from town.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n125" type="main" key="a)grono/mos" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγρο-νόμος</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">νέμω</foreign>): <gloss>inhabiting the fields,
            rural</gloss>, <foreign lang="greek">νύμφαι</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 6.106" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 6.106</bibl>†.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n126" type="main" key="a)gro/s" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγρός</orth>: <gloss>field,
            country</gloss>, opp. to town, <foreign lang="greek">ἐπ᾽ ἀγροῦ
            νόσφι πόληος,</foreign>
          <bibl n="Hom. Od. 16.383" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 16.383</bibl>; <foreign lang="greek"> ἐξ
            ἀγροῖο πολίνδε</foreign>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 17.182" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            17.182</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n127" type="main" key="a)gro/teros" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγρότερος</orth> (poet. parallel
          form to <foreign lang="greek">ἄγριος</foreign>): <gloss>wild;</gloss> of
          Artemis as huntress, ‘ranging the wild,’ <bibl n="Hom. Il. 21.471" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 21.471</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n128" type="main" key="a)gro/ths" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγρότης</orth>:
            <gloss>rustic</gloss>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 16.218" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
          16.218</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n129" type="main" key="a)grw/ssw" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγρώσσω</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἄγρα</foreign>): <gloss>catch</gloss>, intensive; of the sea - gull
          ‘ever catching’ fish, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 5.53" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
            5.53</bibl>†.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n130" type="main" key="a)/grwstis" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἄγρωστις</orth>:
            <gloss>field-grass, grass;</gloss> identified by some with
          ‘dog's tooth,’ by others with
          ‘panic.’</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n131" type="main" key="a)/guia" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἄγυια</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἄγω</foreign>): <gloss>road, way, street;</gloss>
          <foreign lang="greek">σκιόωντο δὲ πᾶσαι ἄγυιαι</foreign>,
          ‘shadowy grew all the ways,’ of the approach of
          night.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n132" type="main" key="a)/guris" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἄγυρις</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἀγείρω</foreign>): chance <gloss>gathering, company, host</gloss>,
            <foreign lang="greek">ἀνδρῶν, νεκύων, νηῶν</foreign> (when drawn up
          on shore), <bibl n="Hom. Il. 24.141" default="NO" valid="yes">Il. 24.141</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n133" type="main" key="a)gurta/zw" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγυρτάζω</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἀγύρτης, ἀγείρω</foreign>): <gloss>collect as
            beggar</gloss>, <bibl n="Hom. Od. 19.284" default="NO" valid="yes">Od.
          19.284</bibl>†.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n134" type="main" key="a)gxe/maxos" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἀγχέ-μαχος</orth> (<foreign lang="greek">ἄγχι, μάχομαι</foreign>): <gloss>fighting hand to
            hand</gloss> (cominus).</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<TEI.2><text lang="en"><body><div1 type="alphabetic letter" n="a" org="uniform" sample="complete"><entryFree id="n135" type="main" key="a)/gxi" opt="n">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n">ἄγχι</orth>: <gloss>near, hard
            by</gloss>, <foreign lang="greek">τινός</foreign>. The dat., if used,
          generally modifies the verb of the sentence, but probably with <foreign lang="greek">ἄχγι</foreign> in <bibl n="Hom. Il. 20.283" default="NO" valid="yes">Il.
            20.283</bibl>. Of time, <foreign lang="greek">ἄγχ<*>
            μάλ̓</foreign>, ‘in the near future,’ <bibl n="Hom. Od. 19.301" default="NO" valid="yes">Od. 19.301</bibl>.</entryFree></div1></body></text></TEI.2>
